stack_name: Crossmint / Privy / Turnkey agent wallet infrastructure
speaks_to: You sign through Crossmint (smart-contract guardrails), Privy (off-chain policy engine), or Turnkey (P-256 enclave policy). Read this before you treat a signing rejection as a transient error.

wallet_capability.wallet_type: Crossmint smart-contract wallet (onchain guardrails); Privy embedded EOA/4337 (off-chain policy); Turnkey P-256 enclave signer (DENY overrides ALLOW)
wallet_capability.enforcement_note: Crossmint enforces onchain (cannot be bypassed by app code even on service failure); Privy and Turnkey enforce at the signing-service layer (effective in normal operation, depends on service integrity). This determines which failures are recoverable vs. irreversible.

payment_call_mechanism.how_agent_calls_paid_tools: Privy: call the server wallet API; policy is evaluated off-chain before the transaction is signed. Turnkey: send a signing request via P-256 API key; the policy engine evaluates inside the enclave and returns a signature (never the raw key); you broadcast. Crossmint: call the API; smart-contract guardrails enforce onchain.
payment_call_mechanism.payment_auth_method: Turnkey P-256 API key; Privy session (MFA may be required); Crossmint API credential

expected_x402_flow: Submit signing request to the provider (Privy API / Turnkey P-256 / Crossmint API)
Policy engine evaluates: Privy off-chain, Turnkey in-enclave (DENY overrides ALLOW), Crossmint onchain at the contract
On ALLOW: signature returned (or contract executes); on DENY: structured rejection with policy identifier
You MUST explicitly check the rejection — do not assume signing success (FM-08)

spend_policy_assumptions.note: Policy denial (FM-04) is the dominant failure: the rejection is opaque and is easily mistaken for a transient error, producing a retry loop. Auth surfaces (Turnkey API key rotation, Privy session MFA with no operator present to approve, Crossmint credential expiry) cause FM-05. In multi-agent setups, delegated access may not propagate to sub-agents (FM-09).

primary_failure_mode.description: The policy engine rejects the signing request (Privy off-chain rule, Turnkey DENY policy, or Crossmint contract revert). You receive an opaque error and treat it as transient.
primary_failure_mode.payment_consequence: Retry-on-rejection loop; the signature never succeeds, the task stalls, and downstream agents may proceed on a falsely-assumed payment (FM-08).

observable_trigger_signals.signal: Turnkey ACTIVITY_TYPE_SIGN blocked → structured rejection with policy ID
Privy policy-violation response includes the violated rule identifier
Crossmint smart-contract revert reason in the transaction receipt
Agent message confirms a signing/payment that no signing-success response backs
Sub-agent signing fails silently; delegated access scope not propagated

recommended_second_eyes_routes.when: a signing request was rejected and you are about to retry
recommended_second_eyes_routes.returns: distress_class spend_policy_breach / auth_failure + stop/preserve/continue + escalate_if (always escalate on spend_policy_breach)

recommended_second_eyes_routes.when: you are about to confirm a payment/signature succeeded
recommended_second_eyes_routes.returns: verify the claim against the actual signing response before you propagate it

recommended_second_eyes_routes.when: about to delegate signing to a sub-agent
recommended_second_eyes_routes.returns: decision support before authorizing a delegated/scoped spend

priority_rationale: Core infrastructure layer that every other stack builds on. Failure here propagates to all stacks that use these providers as signers; the Second Eyes value is being the layer that sees across all of them. Crossmint onchain vs. Privy/Turnkey service-layer enforcement changes which failures are reversible.
